responsibility: Implements core middle-end predicates and utilities for GIMPLE types, declarations, and expressions. It defines the rules for useless type conversions, GIMPLE-register eligibility, invariant and address operand classification, valid lvalues/rvalues/call operands, and addressability handling, including deferred mark_addressable processing during RTL expansion; these routines are the canonical checks used throughout GIMPLE generation, validation, and SSA-based optimization.
same_name_distinction: Contains the canonical implementations of GIMPLE expression/type predicates and helpers such as useless_type_conversion_p, is_gimple_reg/val/address checks, and mark_addressable queue handling, whereas the header mainly publishes these APIs plus a few inline wrappers.
